svg.title: SP500 M30 Monte Carlo equity paths
svg.desc: Representative one-percent-risk equity paths when each greater-than-three-R winner has a ten-percent independent chance of being missed.
svg.text: SP500 M30 Monte Carlo equity paths
10% chance of missing each >3R winner · 1% fixed-fraction risk · $500 start
95% band and paths are drawn from the same frozen 20,000 simulations
Fixed trade order; broker minimum lot not modeled
